title: Open maps into Proj descend along an etale base cover
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $X$ an algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space], $f:X\to T$, and $A$ affine graded algebra data [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Let $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be an etale family such that every scheme test of T lifts fppf locally to a member. Suppose each $X_i=X\times_TT_i$ is a scheme. For graded data $A_i$ and PullbackData $D_i$ over $T_i\to T$, let $r:X\to\operatorname{Proj}_T(A)$ be a map over T, and $r_i:X_i\to\operatorname{Proj}_{T_i}(A_i)$ scheme open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Assume the component maps commute with $D_i.relProjComparison$ on every scheme test of $X_i$. Then r is representable by scheme open immersions. The index universe is arbitrary; no line module, evaluation, generation locus or section algebra is involved.

source.place: Tag 0D3C, canonical map and open-immersion descent paragraph; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 03M4.

proof.text: PullbackData.isPullback identifies each local Proj with the scheme fibre product of global Proj and T_i. Its projection is etale by scheme base change. Applying the covering hypothesis to each scheme test of Proj, followed by the pullback universal property, supplies the fppf-local lifts of the target cover.

The component equation is a commutative square. Its composite with the Proj base-change square is the source Cartesian square, using that r is over T. Pullback cancellation therefore identifies its upper square as Cartesian, so the local pullbacks of r are represented by the given open immersions.

Refine the etale target cover by a small family: cover the small target by its affine opens, and select finitely many affine source opens above each by quasi-compactness and openness of etale morphisms. Their union is small and still covers; base change preserves the local open-immersion property. Apply open-immersion etale locality on this small cover.

theorem space_map_open_proj_base_change
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (T : Over S) (X : AlgebraicSpace S)
    (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) (A : T.left.GradedAlgebraData)
    (I : Type v) (Tᵢ Xᵢ : I → Over S) (g : ∀ i, Tᵢ i ⟶ T)
    (hget : ∀ i, Etale (g i).left)
    (hcover : ∀ (V : Over S) (x : V ⟶ T),
      ∃ R : Sieve V.left, R ∈ Scheme.fppfTopology V.left ∧
        ∀ (W : Over S) (a : W ⟶ V), R a.left →
          ∃ (i : I) (b : W ⟶ Tᵢ i), b ≫ g i = a ≫ x)
    (k : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (Xᵢ i) ⟶ X.obj.obj) (fᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ Tᵢ i)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (k i) (yoneda.map (fᵢ i)) f (yoneda.map (g i)))
    (Aᵢ : ∀ i, (Tᵢ i).left.GradedAlgebraData)
    (D : ∀ i, Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData (g i).left A (Aᵢ i))
    (r : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (projOver T A))
    (hstruct : ∀ (W : Over S) (a : X.obj.obj.obj (op W)),
      (r.app (op W) a).left ≫ A.relProjHom = (f.app (op W) a).left)
    (rᵢ : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ projOver (Tᵢ i) (Aᵢ i))
    (hmap : ∀ (i : I) (W : Over S) (a : W ⟶ Xᵢ i),
      (a ≫ rᵢ i).left ≫ (D i).relProjComparison =
        (r.app (op W) ((k i).app (op W) a)).left)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (rᵢ i).left) :
    IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) r
